note: Known binary residue accepted by D16 (handoff_app_standardization.md): the Go runtime's function table and module information keep package paths (github.com/metacubex/mihomo, sing-tun) inside the Core, and the clients decode the IPC field mihomo_revision. Paths are relative to the scanned tree (the .app, the DMG, the Windows stage, the IPA, the APK; '!' separates an archive from its entry). Only the markers listed may appear in the binaries named; text files may contain none, and the engine revision is allowed nowhere. Changing this file is a review decision.
